# Cloud Sync Handbook

> A short, factual handbook for the Mega desktop app: what it syncs, which systems it runs on, what the free plan includes and how to schedule backups from the command line.

Independent guides to Mega by Cloud Sync Handbook. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Do it
- [Download the Mega desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux](https://mega-sync.github.io/download.html): Get the Mega desktop app download from the official site: version 6.7.0.3, supported systems, the free 20 GB account and four install steps.
- [MEGAcmd backup and sync: schedule Mega backups from the command line](https://mega-sync.github.io/megacmd-backup.html): MEGAcmd backup and sync from the terminal: install, log in, schedule dated backups with a period and a copy count, and avoid losing the setup.

## Decide
- [Mega desktop app review: a generous free plan and real Linux support, with a few gaps](https://mega-sync.github.io/review.html): Mega desktop app review based on vendor documents: two way sync, backups, Linux support, the free 20 GB plan, limits and a score of 8.0 out of 10.
- [Mega pricing and plans: the free 20 GB tier and the Pro plans](https://mega-sync.github.io/pricing.html): Mega pricing explained: the free 20 GB plan, Essential and Pro plan names, Pro I with 3 TB, renewal rules and which prices could not be confirmed.
- [Mega desktop app system requirements for Windows, macOS and Linux](https://mega-sync.github.io/system-requirements.html): Mega desktop app system requirements: Windows 10 or Server 2019, macOS 10.15 Catalina, and Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Fedora or CentOS on Linux.
- [Mega desktop app latest version: 6.7.0.3 and the recent release notes](https://mega-sync.github.io/whats-new.html): The Mega desktop app latest version is 6.7.0.3 (26 October 2026). Summary of the release notes for 6.7, 6.6, 6.5, 6.4 and 6.3 from GitHub.

## Compare
- [Mega alternatives: six cloud storage services and how they differ](https://mega-sync.github.io/alternatives.html): Six Mega alternatives with free storage, encryption model and plan sizes from each vendor's own page: Proton Drive, pCloud, Sync.com, Dropbox and more.

## Full text
- [llms-full.txt](https://mega-sync.github.io/llms-full.txt): every guide on this site in plain markdown
